item.title: 351-Powered 1963 Ford F-100 4×4 Conversion at No Reserve
item.description: This 1963 Ford F-100 left the factory as a two-wheel-drive pickup with an inline-six and manual transmission. It was later retrofitted with a 351ci Cleveland V8, a C6 three-speed automatic transmission, a divorced dual-range transfer case, and Dana 44 axles as part of a build completed under previous ownership. item.title: Original-Owner 2001 BMW 750iL Sport at No Reserve
item.description: This 2001 BMW 750iL is a long-wheelbase example that was purchased new via BMW's European delivery program by the current owner, who specified the car with the Sport Package. Indicating 85k miles, it is powered by a 5.4-liter M73 V12 paired with a five-speed automatic transmission and is finished in Titanium Silver Metallic over gray Montana leather upholstery. item.title: 2023 Ford F-150 Platinum SuperCrew 4×4
item.description: This 2023 Ford F-150 Platinum SuperCrew 4×4 pickup was delivered new to Toliver Ford Mineola in Texas and was purchased new by the seller. item.title: Single-Family-Owned 2002 Cadillac Eldorado ESC at No Reserve
item.description: This 2002 Cadillac Eldorado ESC was purchased new by the seller's parents, and it has 45k miles. The car has been driven sparingly over the past eight years, and work in September 2025 included replacing the brake fluid, rear brake calipers, and rear brake lines. The car is finished in Sable Black with a white landau roof over black leather and is powered by a 4.6-liter Northstar V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transaxle. item.title: 2,900-Mile 2005 Ford GT
item.description: This 2005 Ford GT is one of 2,022 built for the model year, and it is one of 766 units finished in Mark IV Red. Indicating 2,900 miles, the car was initially delivered to Schultz Ford of Nanuet, New York, and it has spent a total of 19 years registered in California and Florida. item.title: 1971 Mercedes-Benz 280SL
item.description: This 1971 Mercedes-Benz 280SL was refurbished at some point prior to the current owner's 2017 acquisition, and its ivory finish is complemented by a black soft top and a red interior. Power is provided by a 2.8-liter inline-six paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes a body-color removable hardtop, 14" steel wheels with painted covers, a push-button radio, and air conditioning. item.title: Supercharged Coyote-Powered 1966 Ford Mustang GT350CR by Classic Recreations
item.description: This 1966 Ford Mustang left the factory as a notch-back coupe and was converted to a fastback as part of a custom build performed by Classic Recreations of Yukon, Oklahoma. The car is finished in Oxford White with blue LeMans stripes over a black vinyl interior, and power is provided by a Roush-supercharged 5.0-liter Coyote V8 linked with a Tremec five-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip rear differential. item.description: This 2022 Acura NSX is #149 of the 350 Type S examples produced, and it has 102 miles through the seller's purchase in 2025. item.title: One-Owner, 16k-Mile 2001 RUF RGT
